notes: The CAC teen page also lists a free Young Adult Lab on Thursdays 4 to 6 pm (open to all teens) and a Teen Art Show for ages 13 to 19. The page has an old closing notice, so call 513-345-8400 to confirm the current schedule.
name: C-YA Teen Council
what_you_do: You join monthly workshops with local artists, tour the museum behind the scenes, and plan a CAC-sponsored teen event. You also post on the teen Instagram account.
who_can_apply: Students enrolled in high school or home-schooled, ages 14 to 18. It is a select group.
pay_detail: Free to join. Dinner is provided at meetings. Perks: free admission, discounted tickets, field trips to museums and universities in another city.
duration: September to May, one meeting a month
deadline_text: The 2026-27 enrollment deadline was July 11. The next deadline is not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the C-YA Teen Council application form on the program page.
